**What changed in the Item system:**
- The save no longer depends on view listeners; `act()` mutes only its own item (and its parents' automatic completion); `set()` refuses functions, DOM nodes and cycles.
- A running task keeps its time after a reload (`ran_since` is saved).
- `name()` / `#id` lines are read everywhere; writing them is one switch (`Store.marked_lines`), off for you to flip.
- `set_<key>` hooks (your old pattern) and `as_call` (a method saved as one call, its body wrapped; no remembering `act`).
- `view.bind(item, key, fn)`: one draw per frame, released when the view is removed.
- Every line is numbered, acked and re-sent after a reconnect or a reload, never written twice; a heartbeat finds a dead socket. Record files still go to Servex first so Approve starts agents; the socket is the fallback.
- Snapshots: `task.snapshot.json` beside the log (the log is never touched); an 8,360-line session loads in ~40 ms instead of ~400 ms.
- Two independent reviews found 14 real bugs (8 in the core, 6 in file moves); all fixed, each with a test. A failed move now puts every rewritten link back.

**Also on michael/dev:** `ext/Chat/md.js` imports `ext/Markdown` but the folder is `ext/markdown`, so the app doesn't load on a case-sensitive host. Fixed on the branch.

**Your calls:** 10 small ones at the end of the plan; each has a recommended answer that the work already follows.

## Answer so far

**Keep your Item / List / Page core. Fix it, don't replace it.** Figma, Linear and tldraw run the same design. Borrow their protocols; adopt libraries only at the edges (Yjs for shared text, SQLite search, Cloudflare voice).

## New tonight: calls vs changes, made concrete

- **Try it: [Replay Lab](https://claude.ai/artifact/1Tj59c1Bz6Y8iq89CiDCT5).** Press Start, wait, press Reload, and compare the two logs. Four examples: a task that spawns an agent, toggle and drag, +1 from two tabs, and asking an AI.
- **The answer: save the changes. Side effects are the reason *not* to re-run a method.** A method changes data (saved), keeps something going in this tab (started from the state, never saved) or acts on the outside world (once, result saved). Calls win only for +1 from two tabs at once, bulk actions like sort, and games.
- **Snapshots:** Figma, Linear, Notion and tldraw load a snapshot plus the changes after it. A snapshot *is* the changes collapsed to the last value of each key, so loading from one is the "changes" answer.
- **New decisions:** D17 how code reacts to a change (your `set_<key>` hook inside the class, `view.bind` for views); D18 which values are saved (tabs and column widths per person; selection, hover and focus never; timers from `started_at`).
- **Worked examples in words:** Phase 1 §2.2 (four kinds of value) and §2.3 (nine examples, from click to reload).
